item.title: Fire erupts at Penticton encampment as province seeks injunction to dismantle site
item.description: Flames at the site next to Highway 97 broke out just before 7 a.m. No one was injured, according to the city, but a structure was destroyed.

item.title: Manitoba government introduces bills on crime, health and other issues

item.title: Chaos in court as Winnipeg man found guilty of mass murder resists sheriffs

item.title: Composting project in Cowessess First Nation promotes sustainability
item.description: A new composting project on Cowessess First Nation is taking the food cycle full circle by rapidly turning compost to soil, allowing the community to grow produce year-round

item.title: Manitoba’s Dunstone, Calvert rinks qualify for Brier playoffs
item.description: Manitoba's Matt Dunstone and Braden Calvert rinks are headed to the playoffs at the Brier.

item.description: A warning for Battlefords residents to not consume any unknown beverages or liquid substances was issued because of the safety risk to residents.

item.title: Lapu Lapu victim’s family says bureaucratic red tape prevents them from getting help
item.description: AJ Sico's mother, Jhosie, said her son used to help pay for the household and the family and his injury has left so much uncertainty.

item.title: Winnipeg Jets take down Lightning 4-1 on eve of trade deadline
item.description: The Jets were able to handle one of the East's top teams with Mark Scheifele, Kyle Connor, Morgan Barron and even Gustav Nyquist finding the back of the net.

item.title: ‘They did it in a very sneaky way’: Uber rider deletes app after cleaning fee dispute over pet
item.description: The Vancouver resident says the incident happened in January when she ordered an Uber to pick up her children from school and brought her five-pound dog along.

item.title: Pentagon labels AI company Anthropic a ‘supply chain risk’
item.description: The Pentagon said in a statement Thursday that it has “officially informed Anthropic leadership the company and its products are deemed a supply chain risk, effective immediately.”
